testo:
Mach Fighter
Triple Breaker
■ When you put this creature, double one of your creature's power until the end of the turn. Then you may choose one of your opponent's creatures. Those 2 creatures battle. If your opponent's creature loses that battle, put all your opponent's creatures that have the same cost as that creature on the bottom of its owner's deck.
